raw_request_summary: Add a governed adapter lane that lets SA and TA request polished diagram-design presentation artifacts downstream of architecture-modeling while preserving pre-design authority and canonical architecture artifacts.

work_items.scope_summary: Add a separately governed presentation-artifact adapter downstream of architecture-modeling without changing SA/TA output ownership or replacing canonical Draw.io, Mermaid, or Structurizr artifacts.
work_items.primary_outcome: SA and TA can request a polished presentation derivative whose facts remain traceable to the canonical architecture model and whose renderer, provenance, and verification are explicit.
in_scope: Define the adapter handoff between SA/TA landscape intent, architecture-modeling facts, and diagram-design presentation rendering
Keep canonical model and governed diagram formats as source of truth
Pin and verify external skill provenance, license, capabilities, and update policy
Add representative contract, traceability, security, parity, packaging, rollback, and UTF-8 checks
Synchronize canonical and managed runtime surfaces only after required gates pass
out_of_scope: Direct diagram generation inside SA or TA
Changing the existing SA/TA output schema or block ownership
Global installation or publication before Release approval
